title: tx_queue.c: pthread_mutex_init return value not checked
description:
Line 217: pthread_mutex_init(&queue->lock, NULL) can fail (EAGAIN, ENOMEM, EPERM) but the return value is ignored. If initialization fails, subsequent lock/unlock operations will have undefined behavior. In practice this is rare with NULL attributes but should be checked for robustness.
